template.name: Previous Day High Low Long
template.notes: On daily bars the previous day is the previous bar, so the break of the prior high is a cross above donchian_high_prev(high,1) filtered by rising ADX with the documented AdxLength=11, and the previous-low break is the exit. MaxProfit=150 and MaxStopLoss=15 are point distances rather than percents, so both fields are null, and the session window and trailing stop cannot be expressed.
